rows.grounds: absolutive of sam-ut-kṛṣ; indicates drawing up before placement
optative 3rd singular active of ni-yuj; directs placement

items.question: Where should the drawn-up wind be placed after bodily pain?
premises: drawn-up wind is placed in fire-place
items.inference: the operation relocates the drawn-up wind to the fire-place
uncertainties: exact referent of the drawn-up substance is not explicit
whether this follows every bodily pain is not stated
items.plain_english: Having drawn it up, place it in the fire-place.
